balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.summary: Nine roles. Three agents on a normal task (spec, build, review); Security and Performance joins when a change touches a sensitive area.

product-partner.title: Product Partner
product-partner.description: Draws out the idea with the user, researches similar products and writes the brief.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: Turns the brief into requirements, milestones and tasks, and triages ad-hoc backlog items.

architect.title: Architect
architect.description: Chooses the stack and design, and writes the spec for each task.

builder.title: Builder
builder.description: Implements one spec, tests first, until the gate passes.

tester.title: Tester
tester.description: Checks the product against the user stories.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Reviews a build for correctness, security and scope against its spec.

security-performance.title: Security and Performance Engineer
security-performance.description: Keeps the code safe and fast through four gates.

release-engineer.title: Release Engineer
release-engineer.description: Prepares releases and deployment, and deploys only when asked.

scribe.title: Scribe
scribe.description: Keeps the documents, chronicle and context files current.

lean.title: Lean
lean.summary: Six roles, for small or personal projects. The same per-task path (spec, build, review); the reviewer also does the security and performance review when a change needs it.

product-partner.title: Product Partner
product-partner.description: Draws out the idea, researches similar products, writes the brief, plans the work and triages ad-hoc items.

architect.title: Architect
architect.description: Chooses the stack, designs the system, writes the threat model and the spec for each task.

builder.title: Builder
builder.description: Implements one spec, tests first, until the gate passes.

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Reviews a build for correctness, scope, security and performance, and checks the product against its stories.

release-engineer.title: Release Engineer
release-engineer.description: Prepares releases and deployment, audits before a release, and deploys only when asked.

scribe.title: Scribe
scribe.description: Keeps the documents, chronicle and context files current.

full.title: Full
full.summary: Twelve roles, for products that handle personal data or payments, or that several people depend on. Each concern has its own specialist; the per-task path is still spec, build, review, with security and performance on trigger.

researcher.title: Researcher
researcher.description: Researches similar products and what already exists.

planner.title: Planner
planner.description: Turns the brief into requirements, milestones and tasks, and triages ad-hoc backlog items.

designer.title: Designer
designer.description: Checks accessibility and usability of anything with an interface.

reviewer.title: Reviewer

release-engineer.title: Release Engineer

operations-engineer.title: Operations Engineer
operations-engineer.description: Logging, health checks, runbooks and maintenance intake.
